versions.content: For a Secured Rx I - PDU with SecOCAuthPduHeaderLength = 0 or not configured and DynamicLength of the referred global Pdu (see ECUC_EcuC_00078) is set to FALSE, the SecOC module shall extract the Authentic I - PDU by using the configured length of the corresponding global PDU.
